about: The engine's English verse numbers for every Gospel chapter, the chapters its English and Latin texts number otherwise (held whole by tools/build_catena.py), and the pairs of adjacent verses the Latin divides otherwise (a section whose first or last verse is either verse of a pair is held). Derived by code from data/bible_en.jsonl and data/bible_la.jsonl (sha256 below); the candidates of three detectors (the word-ratio band, boundary punctuation and speech-formula position) were each read in both texts by builder-30, 2026-11-12, and are listed with what was read. Run 2026-11-11-fathers-shelf, step catena2.

band.ratio: Latin words / English words, split on whitespace

boundary punctuation.rule: verse v ends a sentence ('.', '?', '!') in one text and on a colon in the other; or the Latin ends on a verb of saying and a colon where the English ends a sentence; or the English ends on a verb of saying and ',' or ':' where the Latin ends a sentence

speech-formula position.rule: a verb of saying opens one text's verse v+1 (its first five words) and closes the other's verse v (its last six), and not the other way round
